Our actual results could differ materially from those anticipated in these forward-looking statements as a result of certain factors, including those set forth in the following risk factors and elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 20-F. Any of these risks or other risks currently unknown or considered immaterial may adversely affect our business, as well as our reputation, financial condition and results of operations. Such risks could also adversely impact the market price of our equity shares and/or American Depositary Shares (“ ADSs ”), and investors may lose all or part of their investment. The following risk factors should be considered carefully in evaluating us and our business. Summary of material risks: The following summary provides an overview of the material risks we are exposed to in the normal course of our business activities. The summary does not purport to be complete and is qualified in its entirety by reference to the full risk factors discussion immediately following this summary. credit_strengths.text: The issuer carries a net cash position, with cash and short-term investments exceeding total borrowings, so leverage is effectively negative and well below the sector median on a net basis. Gross leverage also sits comfortably below the sector median, reflecting a conservatively financed balance sheet for an IT services franchise.

Operating cash flow comfortably covers capital expenditure and shareholder distributions combined, leaving substantial internal funding capacity. Free cash flow relative to debt is strong and above the sector median, indicating the business generates more than enough liquidity to retire borrowings without external refinancing.

key_risks.text: Revenue is highly concentrated in Americas and Europe clients and in a few industries, and many contracts can be terminated without cause or notice. Demand is tied to discretionary technology spending, so an economic slowdown or tariff and geopolitical disruption could compress revenue and cash flow quickly.

The debt note shows a large unsecured note maturing in the near term alongside substantial bank lines and overdrafts, meaning refinancing and rollover risk is concentrated in short-dated instruments. A meaningful portion of borrowings is short-term working capital lines across many currencies, exposing the issuer to funding access and FX rollover risk.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Interest coverage is strong in absolute terms, with operating income many times the reported finance costs, though it eased year on year and sits modestly below the sector median. EBITDA coverage similarly remains ample but trails peers, suggesting servicing capacity is robust rather than best-in-class.

The current ratio is comfortably above one and above the sector median, and cash flow relative to debt exceeds the sector median, supporting near-term liquidity. Free cash flow to debt remains above peers but fell year on year, so the cushion is narrowing as borrowings rose.

overall_credit_view.text: The indicative financial risk profile is minimal, anchored by net cash and strong cash conversion. Leverage is below the sector median and coverage is ample, so the issuer's credit profile rests on business stability rather than balance-sheet stress; the main sensitivity is revenue cyclicality in a competitive IT services market.

Shareholder distributions absorb a meaningful share of free cash flow but remain well covered by operating cash flow, leaving room to deleverage or refinance maturities. My judgement is that liquidity and cash generation provide a solid buffer, with refinancing execution and client-spending trends the key monitoring points.

credit_strengths.text: 發行人持有淨現金狀況，現金及短期投資超過總借款，因此槓桿實際上為負值，且按淨額基準遠低於行業中位數。總槓桿亦穩妥地低於行業中位數，反映其作為IT服務業務的資產負債表融資保守。
經營現金流足以輕鬆覆蓋資本開支與股東分派之總和，留有大量內部融資能力。自由現金流相對債務的比率強勁且高於行業中位數，顯示業務產生的流動性遠足以償還借款而無需外部再融資。

key_risks.text: 收入高度集中於美洲及歐洲客戶以及少數行業，且許多合約可在無因或無通知的情況下終止。需求與可支配科技支出掛鈎，因此經濟放緩或關稅及地緣政治干擾可能迅速壓縮收入及現金流。
債務票據顯示一筆大額無抵押票據於短期內到期，同時存在大量銀行額度及透支，意味再融資及展期風險集中於短期限工具。相當部分借款為跨多種貨幣的短期營運資金額度，使發行人面臨融資渠道及外匯展期風險。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 利息覆蓋率按絕對值而言強勁，經營收入為報告財務費用的多倍，儘管按年有所緩和且略低於行業中位數。EBITDA覆蓋率同樣保持充裕但落後同業，顯示償債能力穩健而非業內最佳。
流動比率穩妥地高於一且高於行業中位數，現金流相對債務的比率超過行業中位數，支撐短期流動性。自由現金流對債務的比率仍高於同業但按年下降，因此隨著借款增加，緩衝正在收窄。

overall_credit_view.text: 指示性財務風險狀況為極低，以淨現金及強勁現金轉換為錨。槓桿低於行業中位數且覆蓋率充裕，因此發行人的信用狀況取決於業務穩定性而非資產負債表壓力；主要敏感因素為競爭激烈的IT服務市場中的收入週期性。
股東分派佔用自由現金流的相當部分，但仍獲經營現金流充分覆蓋，留有去槓桿或再融資到期債務的空間。我的判斷是流動性及現金產生提供穩固緩衝，再融資執行及客戶支出趨勢為主要監察重點。
